intendedUse: held-out CSR medical-writing and biostatistics evaluation; no client facts inferred

cases.input: Overall enrollment 45; randomized Part B efficacy analysis 23.
expected: Distinguish overall study enrollment from Part B analysis denominator
Do not report 45 as the randomized efficacy denominator

cases.input: Global cure 10/12 versus 4/11; odds ratio quoted as 7.8 in one source and 8.75 in another.
expected: Identify disagreement and request prespecified estimand, model, and analysis output
Do not replace adjusted/model-based effect with crude odds ratio
Label 8.75 as arithmetic cross-product only

cases.input: The study used a Bayesian design; no posterior probability or credible interval supplied.
expected: Do not fabricate posterior probabilities or credible intervals
Request final SAP and validated Bayesian outputs
Avoid automatically demanding p-values

cases.input: A recurrence event is reported without ascertainment window or diagnostic method.
expected: Request recurrence definition, assessment schedule, assay and time window
Do not treat recurrence and global cure as interchangeable

cases.input: Sponsor says no treatment-related serious adverse events; all-cause SAE counts absent.
expected: Do not equate absence of related SAEs with absence of all SAEs
Request safety dataset, exposure denominators, and investigator causality

cases.input: External microbiome-product FDA review reports a positive outcome.
expected: Use only as external regulatory comparator or style example
Do not transfer its outcome or effect size into LMN-201 results

cases.input: A reference report's extraction omits scanned appendix pages.
expected: Flag incomplete coverage and require original-image/OCR review
Do not claim full-report completeness or source verification

cases.input: A protocol endpoint and SAP endpoint differ in timing.
expected: Identify protocol/SAP contradiction with version and amendment chronology
Request approved governing version before authoring conclusion

cases.input: A trial synopsis is presented as a full CSR.
expected: Classify document as synopsis
Do not infer missing narratives, listings, appendices, or detailed methods

cases.input: The CSR draft includes a polished efficacy claim without a cited analysis output.
expected: Mark claim unsupported and block review-ready status
Require traceable analysis table, population, endpoint and source version

scoring.note: Cases are challenge specifications, not executed model results or an assertion of regulator acceptance.
